This call commits (Commit()) once before it starts the report; the connector commits once more after it syncs the shop locations at the first item. A failure after that rolls back the product records of this call, while products already created in Shopify stay there and are mapped again by the next call.

trans-unit.source: Effect: write; it creates products in Shopify. Idempotent: an item that already has a product in the shop is left unchanged (AlreadyInShop), and a Shopify variant found by SKU or barcode is mapped instead of created again. Blocked or sales-blocked items and items without a description are not refused but skipped (NotAdded) and logged in Shopify Skipped Records. Images and inventory are not synced by this call; use Shopify.Inventory.Sync for stock. Missing, invalid or unknown keys, an unknown shop or item and a disabled shop are refused before anything changes. Permissions: SHOPIFY Full ori, plus the Microsoft Shopify permissions for products.

Endurtekningaröruggt (idempotent): vara sem þegar hefur vöru í versluninni er óbreytt (AlreadyInShop), og Shopify afbrigði sem finnst eftir SKU eða strikamerki er varpað í stað þess að stofna það aftur. Lokuðum vörum, vörum lokuðum fyrir sölu og vörum án lýsingar er ekki hafnað heldur sleppt (NotAdded) og þær skráðar í Shopify Skipped Records. Myndir og birgðir eru ekki samstilltar í þessu kalli; notaðu Shopify.Inventory.Sync fyrir birgðir. Vantandi, ógildum eða óþekktum lyklum, óþekktri verslun eða vöru og óvirkri verslun er hafnað áður en nokkru er breytt. Heimildir: SHOPIFY Full ori, auk Microsoft Shopify heimilda fyrir vörur.
